description: Reference libraries for Project Arrhythmia modding
releaseNotes:
# 25.3.2 [Alpha]
Fixes and minor improvements.

## Changes / Improvements
- New levels now have a very basic setup to help new players get started.
- Objects can't be made to start before 0.001s anymore (shit patch but eh it be what it be...)
- DOF slider on parallax objects has been improved.
- Default parent type has been changed to all parent properties on creation of new parents.
- Some "info blocks" have been updated / changed to better tell what they do.
- Minor UI updates to make editor more uniform.
- Minor improvements to editor performance.

## Bug Fixes
- Fix (as far as i can tell) for the popups not showing in some cases after extended use of the editor.

# [Alpha] -> [Default]
This build is a release candidate build for default. Assuming no major / game breaking bugs are found within 2 days, this build will be promoted to default.
